findings.evidence: Basic.lean:394-396 `hom := constHom (fun i => (hbase i).le) e he`, `inv := constHom (fun i => (hbase i).ge) e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap ...`.
findings.fix: Prove them as `pullbackMap_constHom _ _ _ f` (for `.inv`, with `e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap`), so the fibrewise argument lives only in `pullbackMap_constHom`.
findings.issue: `pullbackMap_constIso_hom` and `pullbackMap_constIso_inv` repeat the `hom_ext`/`simp` argument, although `(constIso hbase e he).hom` is by definition `constHom (fun i => (hbase i).le) e he` and `.inv` is `constHom _ e.symm _`. Both are special cases of `pullbackMap_constHom`.

findings.evidence: Monoidal.lean:65 `associator ... := constIso (fun _ => Set.inter_assoc _ _ _) (kroneckerAssoc ...)`; :68 `leftUnitor` and :71 `rightUnitor` via `constIso`; :160 `tensorComm := constIso ...`.
findings.fix: Derive each one as `pullbackMap_constIso_hom _ _ _ f` / `pullbackMap_constIso_inv _ _ _ f` (by `exact` or `simpa`), instead of re-proving it fibrewise.
findings.issue: `pullbackMap_associator_hom/inv`, `pullbackMap_leftUnitor_hom/inv`, `pullbackMap_rightUnitor_hom/inv`, and `pullbackMap_braiding_hom/inv` each re-prove the same `hom_ext` argument, but every one of these isomorphisms is a `constIso` (Monoidal.lean:64-72, 159-161). They are special cases of `pullbackMap_constIso_hom/inv`, which this PR adds.

findings.evidence: ExteriorPower.lean:200-202 `noncomputable def exteriorPowerOneIso ... := constIso (fun _ => rfl) (exteriorPower.piOneContinuousEquiv 𝕜 A.rank)`.
findings.issue: `pullbackMap_exteriorPowerOneIso_hom/inv` re-prove the fibrewise argument, although `exteriorPowerOneIso A := constIso (fun _ => rfl) (exteriorPower.piOneContinuousEquiv 𝕜 A.rank) _`.

summary: The statements are at the right level, but the PR proves `pullbackMap_constHom` and `pullbackMap_constIso_hom/inv` in general and then re-proves each `constIso` special case (associator, unitors, braiding, `exteriorPowerOneIso`) with its own fibrewise `hom_ext` argument.
